recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future Patient Care decision changes the Condition.severity binding strength or value set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request from the 2015May DAF ballot asking to change the Condition.severity value set binding from example to preferred.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-8245 or #8245 was found. Historical commit 0a6643ad13 changed the old Condition spreadsheet ConditionSeverity conformance from example to preferred, and source rework commit 33b409a4b6 carried that preferred binding into source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes condition=Condition and maps condition to the Patient Care work group, confirming build scope. Searches found no later FHIR-core Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence reversing the preferred binding. Published R4, R4B, and R5 Condition profiles also report Condition.severity with preferred binding strength.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative StructureDefinition already binds Condition.severity to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-severity with strength preferred.
